description: Search from multiple angles simultaneously with deduplication and temporal awareness. Returns merged results by default. Set `merge: false` for per-query results (replaces velixar_batch_search).

merge.description: Merge results across queries (default true). Set false for per-query results.

query_weights.description: Per-query importance weights (same length as queries)

strategy.description: union: all unique. intersection: 2+ query matches only. weighted (default): boost multi-match memories.

threshold.description: For intersection strategy: minimum query match count (default 2)

name: velixar_multi_search
